decisions.statement: A link naming a widget counts a tap on that widget.
A link naming no widget counts nothing.
A tap is counted before the link is routed.
A tap that cannot be counted leaves the routing alone.
A link the router refuses counts its tap all the same.
A link the listener already had is not carried again as the launch link.
The link the app was launched by is counted once however many readers take that link.
One link arriving twice reads as two identical links arriving.
The delivery after the launch link is counted as no tap where the two links match.
A delivery naming another widget spends the launch link's hold on the count.
The widget that launched the app is the only widget that loses a tap this way.
A tap made after the app was launched is told apart from one link arriving twice.

definition: a link the native shell was opened by, carried into the router
